stop_reason: A defensible case is established: a matched, single-project (Alto's Adventure / Snowman) concept-art panel series with four verified, live native PNG artifacts at uniform 1334x750 layout, plus one independent secondary reference (Prune prototype JPEG). All URLs were directly observed, licenses are CC BY-SA 3.0 with VRT tickets, and two native PNGs were confirmed to download as real image files. Remaining gap (semantic pixel content) requires human/vision inspection and cannot be closed with WebFetch. No further distinct, fetchable primary source offering a stronger coherent case was found within budget; additional searching would risk topic-similarity substitutes rather than new case-bearing evidence.
